'''Ordo''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Clan Ordo]], including [[Canderous Ordo]], who became [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] in [[3954 BBY]].<ref name="TOR Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> Mostly a barren desert [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Ordo had some vegetation around its equator.

[[Mandalore the Ultimate]] promised [[Dorjander Kace]] a training center on Ordo, so he could train a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|younglings]] he kidnapped from the [[Jedi Enclave]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. His plan was stopped by [[Zayne Carrick]].<ref name="KOTOR War 5">[[Knights of the Old Republic: War 5|''Knights of the Old Republic: War'' 5]]</ref>
